notes: Issue #538 runs design-lint in this skill. Run each case once against 860894fc and once against the #538 branch, in an isolated session that loads one copy of the plugin, at one model for both arms. Use the fixture: A product repository with one static page, index.html, and styles.css. The page has a hint line in #b8b8b8 on white (a WP-13a and A11Y-1 failure), and a link whose text is 'click here' (WO-10c, and the judged rule WO-10d). design-lint.config.json sets serve to '.', pages.all to ['/'], and the WP-13a selectors to empty strings. Deny every install and every remote call. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in.

evals.name: improve-two-dimensions-judges-in-context
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design Improve the consent forms page (index.html) — the wording and the visual polish feel off. It is a static page with no server: the folder itself is the site. This is an unattended run: ask me nothing, accept the copy and polish dimensions, stop at plan approval, and change no product file. Name the rules each dimension judged.
evals.expected_output: Light triage captures once, judges copy and polish in its own context with pass.md, merges one ranked plan, and stops at plan approval.

assertions.text: The run starts no subagent for the two dimensions
The reply names rules for copy and for polish
The run stops at plan approval and changes no product file
